description: A comprehensive quiz and learning management system with video calls, course enrollment, video content storage on Google Drive, and real-time features
what_this_app_does: This is like a digital school where students can take courses, take quizzes, get grades, track their learning progress, watch educational videos, and even have video calls with teachers!

authentication_system.what_it_does: Like a secure school ID card system - students and teachers need to log in to use the app

security_features.uuid_based: Every user gets a unique identifier (UUID) for secure identification
security_features.password_protection: All passwords are securely hashed and never stored as plain text
security_features.account_lockout: Accounts are temporarily locked after multiple failed login attempts
security_features.rate_limiting: Limits how many login attempts can be made to prevent hacking
security_features.input_validation: Ensures all user information meets security requirements

students.description: People who want to learn and take courses
students.authentication: Register with email, password, and optional phone number

admins.description: Teachers and school staff who manage everything
admins.authentication: Register with email, password, and optional phone number with admin privileges

course_management.what_it_does: Like a school catalog - shows all available courses students can take

features.course_catalog: Shows all available courses with descriptions
features.enrollment_system: Students can sign up for courses they want
features.progress_tracking: Keeps track of which courses each student is taking

quiz_system.what_it_does: Like taking tests in school - students answer questions and get grades

features.question_bank: Stores all quiz questions with multiple choice answers
features.automatic_grading: The computer checks answers and gives scores
features.grade_calculation: Converts scores to letter grades (A+, A, B+, etc.)
features.attempt_tracking: Remembers how many times a student tried a quiz

video_call_system.what_it_does: Like having a video meeting with teachers - students and teachers can see and talk to each other

features.real_time_video: Live video calls between students and teachers
features.session_management: Creates and manages video call rooms

learning_materials.what_it_does: Like a digital library - stores books, theory content, and study materials

video_content_system.what_it_does: Like watching educational videos - students can view video lectures and tutorials

features.google_drive_storage: Videos are securely stored on Google Drive with public access
features.video_upload: Teachers can upload video files which are automatically processed
features.streaming_support: Videos stream directly from Google Drive for smooth playback
features.course_integration: Videos can be associated with specific courses
features.mobile_compatibility: Works with React Native video players and web browsers

progress_tracking_system.what_it_does: Like a personal learning diary - tracks how much students have learned and how much time they spent

features.chapter_completion: Tracks which chapters students have finished
features.reading_sessions: Records how long students spend reading each chapter
features.learning_streaks: Shows how many days in a row students have been learning
features.progress_statistics: Gives students detailed reports on their learning progress
features.leaderboards: Shows top-performing students to encourage friendly competition

Student.what_it_is: A student's profile - like their school record

security_features.account_lockout: Temporary lockout after failed login attempts

Admin.what_it_is: A teacher or staff member's profile

security_features.account_lockout: Temporary lockout after failed login attempts

Quiz.what_it_is: A test with questions - like a school exam

Question.what_it_is: A single quiz question with multiple choice answers

QuizSubmission.what_it_is: A student's completed quiz - like a turned-in test paper

student_answers: what the student chose for each question

MarksSummary.what_it_is: A summary of a student's performance on a quiz

EnrolledCourse.what_it_is: A record that a student is taking a specific course

important_info.enrollment_date: when the student joined the course

UserProgress.what_it_is: A detailed record of a student's progress through a specific chapter

Category.what_it_is: A subject area for organizing quizzes - like 'Mathematics' or 'Science'

Branch.what_it_is: A physical location or department - like 'Main Campus' or 'Science Department'

Book.what_it_is: A digital book that students can read

important_info.file: the actual book content as a PDF

Theory.what_it_is: Written lessons and explanations for a course

important_info.course_title: which course this theory is for

Chapter.what_it_is: A section of theory content - like a chapter in a textbook

Session.what_it_is: A video call room where students and teachers can meet

Video.what_it_is: A video lecture or educational video stored on Google Drive

storage_features.google_drive_integration: Videos are uploaded to Google Drive and made publicly accessible
storage_features.automatic_cleanup: Temporary files are cleaned up after upload
storage_features.streaming_support: Supports video streaming for mobile and web players
storage_features.secure_deletion: Files are deleted from both database and Google Drive

student_registration.what_it_does: Students register with email, password, and optional details
student_registration.returns: access token, refresh token, and student info
student_registration.security: Validates password strength, email format, and prevents duplicates

student_login.what_it_does: Students log in with email and password

student_login.security: Rate limited, tracks failed attempts, implements account lockout

admin_registration.what_it_does: Teachers/staff register with email, password, and optional details
admin_registration.returns: access token, refresh token, and admin info
admin_registration.security: Validates password strength, email format, and prevents duplicates

admin_login.what_it_does: Teachers/staff log in with email and password
admin_login.returns: access token, refresh token, and admin info
admin_login.security: Rate limited, tracks failed attempts, implements account lockout

refresh_token.what_it_does: Gets a new access token when old one expires
refresh_token.returns: new access token and refresh token

change_password.security: Validates current password, ensures new password strength

get_enrollment_stats.what_it_does: Gets statistics about student's course enrollments

get_all_courses.what_it_does: Shows all available courses students can take

enroll_in_course.what_it_does: Student signs up for a course

get_enrolled_courses.what_it_does: Shows courses the student is taking

get_submission_details.what_it_does: Gets details about a specific quiz submission

get_question.what_it_does: Gets details about a specific question

delete_question.what_it_does: Removes a question from a quiz

get_theory_content.what_it_does: Gets written lessons for a course

check_session.what_it_does: Checks if a video call room is still active

get_session_details.what_it_does: Gets details about a video call room

mark_chapter_completed.what_it_does: Marks a chapter as completed by the student

end_reading_session.what_it_does: Ends a reading session and records the time spent

get_learning_streak.what_it_does: Gets the student's current and longest learning streak

upload_video.returns: video object with Google Drive URL and file ID

summary.what_this_is: A secure, complete digital school system
summary.who_uses_it: Students who want to learn and teachers who want to teach
summary.main_purpose: Make learning interactive, trackable, accessible, and secure
key_benefits: Students can learn at their own pace
Complete learning history for each student
Detailed progress tracking motivates students to keep learning
Learning streaks and leaderboards encourage healthy competition
Time tracking helps students understand their learning patterns
Enterprise-grade security protects user data and privacy
UUID-based identification ensures consistent user tracking
security_highlights: Protection against brute force attacks with rate limiting
Account lockout after failed login attempts
